translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Tummagan igal-amismalad Jesús-mesgal
Tegin Jesús tulemalga pél chunmasgu, aga e-chapinganga chogal:
—Imi pemal pato wismaldo, Pab-Najad-Itoged ibboje naigunoniko. Tenal te ibegin an-Te-Tule-Chunna uklenoniko nakrusgin pioklegal.
Tenal teun tule-irwal-Pabzhe-kolmalad-e-tummagan tegin Judio-chelegan-tummagan, tule-irwal-Pabzhe-koled-pul-tummad-Caifás-e-neg-tummadgin ormasmal.
Tenal we Judio-tummagan igal-aminanimal otukal Jesús-kagal, tegin Jesús-mesgalbal.
Tenal Judio-tummagan chogalmalbal: —Tenal anmal Pab-Najad-Itoged-naidgin melle Jesús-kamalo. Tegil tulemal ulualmalal, neg-impabal aknidmalo anmalbak urwegal.
Ome Jesús-nonogin ti-wawad imajad
Imi Jesús Betania-neg-kweburgin-maidgin, teun Jesús Simón-lepra-poni-nika-nad-neggin mas kuntii.
Tegin Jesús ampa mas kunchiidgin, ome-walgwen Jesúszhe noni. Tegin we ome alabastro-pudegin ti-wawad-peyedzhe-karked cheinoni. Tegin ome Jesús-nonogin ti-wawad imas.
Tenal Jesús-e-chapingan ome-takchamalgu Jesúsgin-ti-wawad-imas, istar ome-takalmal. Tegin Jesús-e-chapingan chogalmal: —¿Imi we omede, ibiga pinche ti-wawadgin mani owes-wede?
Imi we ti-wawad yer karkegu-choggu, al mani-tummadgin ukchalen, pul nabirin, we manigin tule-wilemalad-pentagal.
Tenal Jesús e-chapingan-chunmajad itosgu, aga e-chapinganga chogal: —¿Ibiga pe we omegin urwenanimal-wede? We ome anka ib-nued imas.

Tenal ome an-purkwed-iktual ankin ti-wawad imas tule-tigzhogalidyob. Imi tule anka immal-ukpiel, imis anka ukenab. Tenal antin pemalbak ilgwen-kwen-nadguojul, tenal tule-wilemalad kwen chulguojul-kuo, pemalbak keg-chulgu kudigumalo.
“Tenal an chunchunnad pemalga chogdo: imi iti-napkin meke-pia an-kaka-nuegan choglegoedgin, we ome imis ankin ti-wawad-imajad ampa choglemogo, tulemal we omegin wis pinzhemalgal.”
Judas-Iscariote manibal Jesúsgin akpitchad
Tegin Jesús-e-chapingan-walambe-kakabogwad-walgwen Judas-Iscariote-nugad tule-irwal-Pabzhe-kolmalad-e-tummaganzhe nad, manigin Jesús-ukegal.
Tegin Judas Judio-tummaganga chogal: —¿Igi-mani anka pe uko, an pega Jesús-ukegal? Tegin Judio-tummagan ilgwen Judasga mani-chibu-tulabogiid-kwa-tulagwen-kakaambe ukchamal.
Al Judas teun-akar igal-aminaigual Judio-tummaganga Jesús-ukegal.
Jesús aga e-chapinganbak napi mas kuchad
Tegin Madu-Ina-Nikchulid-Kunned-Ibe kep-naigudedgin, e-chapingan Jesúszhe nonimal chogalmal: —¿Tummad, pia pe pei, anmal pega neg nudamalgal Pab-Najad-Itogedgin mas kunmalgal?

Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogal: —Imi pe neg-kweburzhe nemalo, tule-an-pega-chogoedzhe. Tenal pe we tulega chogo: ‘Tule-oturdaked chog, e-wilub pato omodani-choggu, al ede aga e-chapinganbak pe-neggin Pab-Najad-Itoged-mas wis kunpimal.’
Tegin Jesús-e-chapingan Jesús-ega-chogzhadyob pél immal imasmal. Tenal Jesús-e-chapingan Pab-Najad-Itogedgin mas imasmalzhun. Tenal Jesús kep te-cholbal nonimojun aga e-chapinganbak mes mas kunkal.
Tegin neg-chedosgu, Jesús aga e-chapingan-walambe-kakabogwadbak mes mas kunchimo.
Tenal Jesús mas-kunpukwadgin aga e-chapinganga chogal: —Imi an chunchunnad pemalga chogdo: pemal-walgwen manibal ankin akpinnoniko.
Al Jesús-e-chapingan peyedzhe pukib-itononimal. Tenal e-chapingan-ilbal Jesúsga chogalmal: —¿Tummad, an pegin akpinnonikodé? Chulá.
Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogalbal: —Tenal pemal-walgwen anpak mes madu wartichajal, we tule ankin-akpinnonikoed.
Tenal Pab-kartagin nermakal-maidyob an-Te-Tule-Chunnagin kunoniko. Tenal tule-ankin-akpinnonikoed sapejul oturdalegoedbal peyedzhe wilesma. Al we tule pul mimmileszhulilen, pul nabirin.
Tenal Judas-Jesúsgin-akpinnonikoed Jesúszhe ekichial: —¿Tule-oturdaked, áni? Tegin Jesús Judasga chogal: —Pedo.

Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganbak ampa mas-kunpukwadgin Jesús madu chus. Tegin Jesús tog-nuedi Pab Tummadga chogzha. Tegin Jesús purwi-purwi madu pipichisgu, aga e-chapinganga madu ukcha. Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogalbal: —Chu. Kunmal. Wedin an-chan. Tegin Jesús-e-chapingan we madu kuchamalzhun.
Tegin Jesús kobed chusbalgu, tog-nuedi Pab Tummadga chogzhabal. Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga kobed ukchabal. Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogalbal: —Pemal-pel-kwapa we kobed pe kobmalo.
Imi we kobed an-abe. Tenal an-abedin oyonai, Pab-Tummad-kaka-pin-ukchad ib-chunchunnad. Al an-abe milenoniko, tulemalga-ichejul iskued eligal.
Tenal an pega chogdo: imi antin imis-akar uva-nis pal kwen kobojul, an-Pab-neg-takmaidgin pemalbak kannan uva-nis kobbaloedzhe. Pitogua. Tegin Jesús-e-chapingan we kobed kobzhamalzhun.
Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganbak namakedgin Pab-otummosmalgu, ilgwen nadmal, Olivo-yalzhe.
Jesús Pedroga chogzhagujad: “Pedin ankin chogdago: ‘An Jesús-kwen-wichul’ ”
Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogal: —Pemal imis-mutik pel-kwapa an-midmalo, Pab-kartagin chogzhadyob. Tenal Pab Tummad purpal chogzhado:
Tegin Jesús chogalbal: —Imi an purkwaled-akar an kannan tullejal, an pe-iktual Provincia-Galileaje nao.
Tenal Pedro Jesúsga chogal: —Imi tule-pimalad pél pe-midmalal, tenal antin meke-igi pe-kwen-metojul.
Tegin Jesús Pedroga chogal: —Imi an chunchunnad pega chogdo: imis-neg-kabgwen ampayo kallin-mastad namakeddu, pedin ilapá ankin chognoniko: ‘Antin Jesús-kwen-wichul.’

Tegin Pedro Jesúsga chogalbal: —Chulá. Imi an pebak purkwejogel, an akalzhul pebak purkwemogo. Tenal antin pegin kwen chogojul, an pe-kwen-wichul. Tenal Jesús-e-chapingan-pimalad ampa Pedro-chogzhad-yopí chogalmalmo.
Jesús Getsemanígin Pabzhe napi kochad

Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganbak nadmalzhun Getsemaní-neg-nugadzhe. Tegin Jesús Getsemaní omosmalgu, aga e-chapinganga chogal: —Imi pemal wegin peimalgwelo. Tenal antin webal Pab Tummadzhe wis kolnegwelo.
Tegin Jesús walapá aga e-chapingan-ches, Pedro tegin Zebedeo-machimal-walbo. Tenal Jesús ega ib-kuoedgin peyedzhe-pukib-itononikidbal chuli-pinzhe-kual.

Tegin Jesús aga e-chapingan-walapágwadga chogal: —Imi an ulubgin peyedzhe-pukib-itogedbal ankin purkwed ode. Imi pemal wegin an-abintagwelo. Tenal pemal anpak mes alamakenabmalmo Pabzhe kolgal, tenal pe melle kabmalo.

Tegin Jesús iche-ukin wis nadgu, ilgwen tullu-chigwis nono-napche. Tegin Jesús Pabzhe kolal chogal: “An-Pabye, imi an ina-kakpid-kobneedyob wilegoedgin nabir noo pe an-takel, pe an-onogoye. Tenal an-itolegedbal-chul, tenal pe-itolegedbalye.”

Tegin Jesús Pabzhe kochagu, kannan e-chapingan-pukwadzhe nonibal. Tegin Jesús e-chapingan-taknoni pato kabmamimal. Tegin Jesús aga e-chapingan-otasgu, Pedroga chogal: —¿Imi pemal anpak mes wachilgwen pel atabijulmaldé Pabzhe kolgal?
Tenal pemal atagenabmal. Tegin pe Pabzhe kolenabmalbal imis-immal-kuoedgin pe melle wilub-taklegal, tegin pe melle an-midmalgal. Tenal pe-purpadin peien Pabzhe kolgal, tenal pe-chandin lolló.

Tegin Jesús kannan nadbal Pabzhe kolgal. Wegin Jesús ilabogus Pabzhe-kolgus. Tenal Jesús Pabzhe kolalbalgu, chogalbal: “An-Pabye, imi an inna-kakpid-kobneedyob an peyedzhe wilegoed-akar keg noo pe an-takel, pe akalzhul pe-itolegedbal an-imajunnoye.”
Tegin Jesús kannan e-chapinganzhe nonibalgu, e-chapingan-taknoni pato kabmamimalbal. Tenal Jesús-e-chapingan-e-imiadin pela-pela kabbiedbal a-ito chaktilebimal.
Tenal Jesús aka-pukwa e-chapingan-ebesgu, kannan nadbal Pabzhe kolgal. Wegin Jesús ilapá-kuo Pabzhe-kolgus. Tenal Jesús ampa akpenegwadyob kannan Pabzhe kolalbal.
Tegin Jesús kannan e-chapinganzhe nonibalgu, aga e-chapinganga chogal: —¿Imi pemal ampa kabmamimal ulukumamimalyé? Imi an-wilub pato noni. Al an-Te-Tule-Chunna tule-iskanaje uklenoniko.
Imisgin pe kwisgumaldo. Nemal. Imi tule-manigin-ankin-akpitchad pato wegin tani.
Judio-tummagan Jesús-kasmalad

Tegin Jesús ampa aga e-chapinganga chunma-kwichidgin Judas-Jesús-e-chapingan-walambe-kakabogwad-walgwen noni. Tenal tulemal-ichejul Judasbak irmanonimalmo. Tenal tule-nonimalad es-pilacheed-annik nonimal. Tegin we tulemal chowal-oro-annik nonimalbal. Tenal tule-nonimalad, tule-irwal-Pabzhe-kolmalad-e-tummagan tegin Judio-chelegan-tummagan-tar-palmialmalad Jesús-kagal.
Imi teun takalgu, Judas-Jesúsgin-akpitchad iktual tule-nonimaladbak igal-mezhis ka chogzhado: “Imi anmal we tule-abingujal, an we tule-wagal us pe an-takel, pe we tule-kao.”
Al Judas ilgwen Jesús-abir kwisgunonigu, chogal: —Anná. ¿Tule-oturdaked, pede? Tegidgin Judas Jesús-wagal us.
Tegin Jesús Judasga chogal: —An-ai, imi pe aga noni-choggu, imisgin pe imado. Tegin tulemal-Judasbak-nonimalad Jesús-abir kwisgunonimalgu, ilgwen Jesús-kasmalzhun.
Tegin tulemal Jesús-kadmalgu, Jesús-e-pakad-walgwen es-pilacheed unnus. Tegin Jesús-pakad tule-irwal-Pabzhe-koled-pul-tummad-e-mos-chiktegu, chuchubi kaledap-idirrí.
Tenal Jesús e-pakadga chogal: —Wejego. Es pe kannan uka-yabal yoo. Imi tule-pel-kwapa esgin urwemalal, esgin etimial purkwemogo.
¿Imi an Pabzhe kolelen, pemal ebinzhe Pabde imis-imis anka mili-tulapá-kakaambe-angelmal-palmidagojul an-pentagal? Pab anka palmidagodo.
Tenal an-chogzhadyob kuelen, ¿tede igi kuo Pab-kartagin-nermakal-maidyob kunonigal? Keg kue. Tenal antin yabli kaleged-wilub.

Tegin Jesús apka-tégin tulemal-e-kanonimaladzhe ekichial chogal: —¿Ibiga pemal es-pilacheed-annik tegin chowal-oro-annik an-kadanimal-wede, an-kantikidgin-immal-aturzheed-tuleyob? Imi antin pane-pane Pabzhe-koled-neggin tulemal-oturdadi-kus. Tenal pemal an-kwen-kabijulmal.
Tenal pél weob immal kunaid, Pab-kaka-palchogmalad akpene Pab-kartagin-nermajad-yopí kunonigal. Tegidgin Jesús-e-chapingan pél Jesús-midmal, walagwen Jesús-ebesmal.
Judio-tummagan Jesúsga igal-itosmalad
Tegin tule-Jesús-kasmalad tule-irwal-Pabzhe-koled-pul-tummad-Caifászhe Jesús-chesmal. Tenal teun takalgu, Caifás-neggin Moisés-igalgin-tulemal-oturdamalad tegin Judio-chelegan-tummagan ormanonimal.
Tenal Pedrodin Jesús-cholbal untar-panku pinna-pinna nad, Caifás-negzhe. Tegin Pedro neg-impaje togzhagu, Pabzhe-koled-neg-takmaladbak mes chigwismo takegal, Judio-tummagan igi Jesús-imamalo-dewa.

Tegin tule-irwal-Pabzhe-kolmalad-e-tummagan tegin Judio-tummagan-wala-tulapá-kakaambegwad walbo tule-aminaigualmal kakanzheedgin yopí chogmalgal Jesús Pab-Tummadgin-ataszhulidbal purkweenab. Tenal Judio-tummagan tule-kwen-onoszhulmal Jesúsgin yopí choggal.
Tenal tulemal-íchejul Jesúsgin pinche kakanzhasmalan, tenal we tulemal yopí kwen chogzhajulmal. Al Judio-tummagan kwen unnijul-kusmal Jesúsgin choggal, Jesúsde purkweenab.
Tenal napigin tule-walbo chognonimal: —Imi we tule chogzhado ede nabir we Pabzhe-koled-neg eyaro. Tegin ede ibapágin kannan pel-kwapa Pabzhe-koled-neg chobbalo.
Tegin tule-irwal-Pabzhe-koled-pul-tummad okwichial, Jesúsga chogal: —¿Imi we tule pegin chogzhadgin pe chogojulmoyé?

Tenal Jesús ilgwen yakír pes. Tegin tule-irwal-Pabzhe-koled-pul-tummad Jesúsga chogalbal: —Imi Pab-Tummad-Tulad-nuggin an pega chog: pedin keg-chulgu anka chogenab, pedin Cristo, Pab-Machi-chunchunnad o chul.

Tegin Jesús Judio-tummadga chogal: —Antin, Pab-Machido. Tenal an pemalga chogmodo: pemal imis-akar pe an-takmalo, an-Te-Tule-Chunna Pab-pela-pela-kannaleged-nikad-nuedzhik tule-tummadga chii. Tegin pemal an-takmalbalo nikpa mogil-impabal aktedani.

Tegidgin tule-irwal-Pabzhe-koled-pul-tummad istar-Jesús-chunmajad-itojadbal aga chiir mol imas. Tenal tule-irwal-Pabzhe-koled-pul-tummad Judio-tummagan-pimaladga chogal: —Imi we tule-chunmajad istar Pab Tummadgin chunmas. ¿Ibiga anmal tule-pid-pal-amio, we tulegin choggal wedin tule-iskana? Imi pemal-pel-kwapa-pukwad ual itosmal, ede istar Pab Tummadgin chunmas.
¿Tenal igi pe chogmalmódin? Tegin Judio-tummagan chogalmal: —Imi we Jesúsdin keg-chulgu purkweenab.
Tegin Judio-tummagan kep Jesús-wagalgin kwi-mialmal, tegin chunkalgin Jesús-sakismalbal. Tenal tule-wal-walgwen Jesús-e-takchulidgin twas Jesús-imasmalbal.

Tenal tule-Jesús-sakijad Jesúsga chogalmal: —Imi pe Cristo-Pab-akpene-chogzhad-palmidagoed-tule-choggu, imisgin pe chogdo, toa pe-ebios. Tenal Jesús we tulemalga immal kwen chogzhajul-kus, ilgwen yakir pes.
Pedro ilapá Jesúsgin chogzhagujad ede Jesús-kwen-wichul
Tegin Pedro neg-impabal ampa chiidgin, puna-mos-walgwen Pedroga chognoni: —¿Imi pe we Jesús-Galileaginedbak pe kudimoganzhulzhí?
Tegin Pedro pel-kwapa-tulemal-wagin chogal: —Chulá. An wichí toagin pe chunmanai.
Tegin Pedro kwisgudgu, nad. Tegin Pedro wanagak omosgu, puna-pid tar-takalbal. Tenal puna tule-aka-pukmaladga chogal: —We tule, Jesús-Nazaretkinedbak kudimogan.
Tegin Pedro chogalbal: —Chulá. Imi an napírra chunchunnad an pega chogdo: antin we tule-kwen-wichul.
Tegin apka te-cholbal, tule-aka-pukmalad Pedroje nonimal chogalmal: —Tenal an penzhul pedin we tule-e-pakadmo. Imi pe-chunmaked ampa tule-kalejad-yopí chunmamo.
Tegin Pedro chogalbal: —Imi an kakanzheelen, Pab akalzhul sapejul an-oturdakoen. Tenal antin we tule-kwen-wichul. Tegidgin kallin-mastad apka-pakal namakal.

Tegin Pedro kep wisgud-nad, akpene igi Jesús ega chogzhagujad. Tenal Jesús akpene Pedroga chogzhado: “Yo kallin-mastad namakeddu, pe ilapá ankin chogo: ‘An Jesús-kwen-wichul.’ ” Tegin Pedro ilgwen magadbal nodgu, pela-pela-pukib-itogedbal pononijun.
